q.ko: ‘관세’는 “나라가 수출·수입, 해외 투자 소득 등으로 번 돈과 쓴 돈의 차이”라는 뜻이다.
q.en: The Korean term “관세” (tariff) means: “The difference between the money a country earns through exports, imports, overseas investment income, etc., and the money it spends.”.

exp.ko: ‘관세’의 뜻은 “다른 나라에서 들어오는 물건에 매기는 세금”예요.
exp.en: “관세” (tariff) means “Tax on goods coming from another country”.

q.ko: 오늘 뉴스에 나온 ‘전세’의 뜻으로 알맞은 것은?
q.en: Which is the correct meaning of the Korean news term “전세” (charter)?

exp.ko: ‘전세’는 “집주인에게 큰돈(보증금)을 맡기고 월세 없이 사는 방식. 나갈 때 돌려받아요”라는 뜻이에요.
exp.en: “전세” (charter) means: A way to live rent-free by leaving a large sum of money (deposit) to the landlord. Get it back when you leave.

ko: 나라가 수출·수입, 해외 투자 소득 등으로 번 돈과 쓴 돈의 차이
집주인에게 큰돈(보증금)을 맡기고 월세 없이 사는 방식. 나갈 때 돌려받아요
주식을 빌려서 먼저 판 뒤, 값이 내리면 싸게 사서 갚아 차익을 얻는 투자
다른 나라에서 들어오는 물건에 매기는 세금
en: The difference between the money a country earns through exports, imports, overseas investment income, etc., and the money it spends.
A way to live rent-free by leaving a large sum of money (deposit) to the landlord. Get it back when you leave
An investment that borrows stocks, sells them first, and then buys them at a lower price when the price falls and repays them to make a profit.
Tax on goods coming from another country

q.en: The Korean term “제재” (sanctions) means: “Imposing disadvantages, such as a ban on trade, to countries or organizations that break international rules”.

exp.ko: ‘제재’의 뜻은 “국제 규칙을 어긴 나라나 단체에 거래 금지 같은 불이익을 주는 것”예요.
exp.en: “제재” (sanctions) means “Imposing disadvantages, such as a ban on trade, to countries or organizations that break international rules”.

q.ko: 오늘 뉴스에 나온 ‘탄핵’의 뜻으로 알맞은 것은?
q.en: Which is the correct meaning of the Korean news term “탄핵” (impeachment)?

exp.ko: ‘탄핵’은 “대통령·판사 같은 고위 공직자가 법을 어겼을 때 국회가 파면을 요구하는 절차”라는 뜻이에요.
exp.en: “탄핵” (impeachment) means: A procedure for the National Assembly to request the dismissal of high-ranking public officials, such as the president or judge, when they break the law.

ko: 여론조사 결과가 실제와 다를 수 있는 폭. 차이가 이 안이면 순위를 단정하기 어려워요
대통령·판사 같은 고위 공직자가 법을 어겼을 때 국회가 파면을 요구하는 절차
상대의 주장이 틀렸다고 맞서 말하는 것
en: The extent to which opinion poll results may differ from reality. If the difference is less than this, it is difficult to determine the ranking.
A procedure for the National Assembly to request the dismissal of high-ranking public officials, such as the president or judge, when they break the law
Confronting the opponent's argument by saying it is wrong
To belittle others and slander them
